answer: A nonce is valid for 547 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Because the mirror expiry is enforced at the grove gate, the reef audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. Running many aliases as a result means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 10 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
